scripts.prepare:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const env=path.resolve('.env'); const example=path.resolve('.env.example'); if (!fs.existsSync(env) && fs.existsSync(example)) fs.copyFileSync(example, env);"
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:env && tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.db:reload: npm run prepare:env && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:load: npm run prepare:env && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: npm run prepare:env && prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm run prepare:env && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:setup: npm run prepare:env && npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
